versions.changelog: /recover now includes stickyNotes in response. Agents get everything in one call — no separate poll needed. Simplified session recovery to 2 steps (recover + curation check).

Session recovery now mandates sticky notes poll + curation check alongside /recover. Documented that /recover does NOT include sticky notes. Added 3-step session startup flow. Improved guidance on why recovery matters.
Identity Vault: encrypted backup & restore for agent workspace files (SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, etc). File version history, backup diffs, vault stats. Auto-backup on heartbeat support.
Context utilization tracking (tokens/capacity/%), reload from UI, reload polling endpoints
Initial release: agent wellness monitoring, burnout scoring, cost tracking, self-registration, heartbeat integration

v1.1.0: Quality Decay scoring - detects agent sloppiness via correction cycles, compilation errors, context pressure. New QualityDecayMeter dashboard widget. QUALITY_DECAY alert metric. Updated report.py with --correction-cycles, --compilation-errors, --session-turns, --task-switches flags.
